question: If the position of the first and second letters in the word MOTHERLAND were interchanged, also the third and the fourth letters were interchanged, the fifth and sixth letters were interchanged and so on, which of the following would be the sixth letter from the right?
solution:

When we apply the given condition to the word MOTHERLAND, we get:
